decisions.diagnosis: Before the camera was reconfigured during the 2024-11-30..2024-12-08 outage, the King Georges Rd (E) zone was dominated by false bicycle detections after dark: its evening surge starts at dusk and moves with sunset through the year, and the level fell twentyfold at the reconfiguration.
decisions.evidence: 881/927 ran at 150-350 bikes/day each (Sep-Nov 2024 hourly: 30-40/h at 19-22h and 2-7/h at 00-05h), then ~10-20/day from 2024-12-09 with a flat daytime profile (0.3-0.8/h). The surge onset tracks darkness: 17-18h in Jul 2023, 20-22h in Dec 2023 (with a dip to 2.9/h at 19h), 19-20h in Mar 2024. Monthly means were highest in winter (Jul 2023 269, Aug 2024 346) and lowest in summer (Dec 2023 152), which fits darkness rather than riding.

decisions.diagnosis: Across the whole record, most counts at the M5 off-ramp crossing are dark-hour false detections (the same artefact as site 387 before December 2024), so the daily totals do not measure riding.
decisions.evidence: Daytime counts for 694/709 are 0.0-0.3/h, but evening counts are 1.5-5/h and begin at dark: 18h in Jul 2023 and Jun 2026, 20-21h in Dec 2023 and Dec 2025 (Dec 2023 694: 17h 1.2, 19h 0.6, 21h 4.4, 22h 5.0). Night hours make up roughly two-thirds of each day's total. The level fell from ~35 to ~18/day at the Dec 2024 reconfiguration, but the pattern remained.

decisions.diagnosis: From midday on 2025-05-22 the camera stopped detecting almost everything in all ten zones for three weeks, and the automatic fix caught only some directions.
decisions.evidence: Across the camera, raw totals were ~50/day on 10-21 May, 0-4/day from 23 May to 12 Jun, and ~40/day on 13 Jun. Directions 823, 852, 784 and 884 kept many of these near-zero days as valid zeros (weeks of 26 May and 2 Jun: 0-1 per direction).
784 had 96 valid slots per day on 23-28 May and 7-12 Jun with totals of 0-2/day, against 3-13/day before and after.
884 kept 96 valid slots on every day from 22 May to 12 Jun, totalling 2 bikes in 22 days.
927 had valid zeros on 23-25 May and 10-12 Jun, against 4-14/day before.

decisions.diagnosis: The King Georges Rd crossing read about five times higher before the Dec 2024 camera reconfiguration than after it, so its zone may have been redrawn; unlike site 387, its profile is commuter-shaped and has no dark-hour artefact.
decisions.evidence: 884/915 ran at 12-24 and 9-18/day (Jul 2023-Nov 2024) and 1-6/day from Dec 2024. The hourly profile before Dec 2024 has AM (6-7h) and PM (16-18h) peaks and almost nothing at night. Sites 384 and 385 did not step at the reconfiguration.

summary: A single VivaCity camera (counter 285) covers five zones at the M5 westbound ramps / King Georges Rd, and there are no other counters or sites, so no series are defined. Before the camera was reconfigured in Dec 2024, zone 387 was swamped by dark-hour false detections (150-350/day, surging at dusk and shifting with sunset), and zone 388 carries the same artefact throughout its record; both are set missing. The whole camera nearly stopped detecting from 2025-05-22 to 2025-06-12, and that period is set missing for every zone. The zone-386 level before the reconfiguration is marked uncertain; the automatic outage fixes (Jul-Aug 2023, Apr-Aug 2024, Nov-Dec 2024) are correct.
